ja: 月刊ホビージャパンで連載の外伝『境界戦機 フロストフラワー』より、メイレスビャクチと並び“際の極光”で運用される機体セツロを商品化。
ブルーを基調とした機体カラーを成形色で再現。武装を新規造形で再現。
●　「セツロ」機体カラーリングを再現
北米同盟が使用する旧型機体ジョーハウンドを鹵獲、チューンアップしたセツロをブルーとグレーを基調とした成形色で再現。
●　各種武装、装備が新規造形で付属
ウインチユニット、グレネード予備弾ケースが新規造形で付属。さらに脚部スレッド装着状態をパーツ選択式で再現可能。
ウインチユニット
肩部に装着するウインチユニットは射出状態をリード線で再現。展開状態のアンカーパーツが付属。
脚部スレッド
脚部は通常状態に加え、湿地帯移動用装備「スレッド」装着状態をパーツの選択式で再現。
●　駐機状態を再現可能
脚部の関節機構により、膝立ちでの駐機状態が再現可能。
●　新規書き下ろしフルカラーパッケージでお届け
付属武装： ウインチユニット装備 ／ アンカー（ツメ展開） ／ 腰背部ウェポンラック（スペア弾倉付） ／ グレネード予備弾ケース　／ ライフル ／ 脚部スレッド

en: From the side story ``Kyoukai Senki Frost Flower'' serialized in Hobby Japan, we have commercialized the aircraft Setsuro, which is operated in the ``Aurora no Kyokuhin'' along with Meires Byakuchi.
The blue-based aircraft color is reproduced with molding color. Weapons are reproduced with new modeling.
● Reproduce the "Setsuro" aircraft coloring
The old model Jawhound used by the North American Alliance was captured and the tuned-up Setsuro is reproduced in molding colors based on blue and gray.
● Various weapons and equipment are included in new shapes.
A winch unit and a spare grenade bullet case are included with new modeling. Furthermore, the state in which the leg threads are attached can be reproduced by selecting parts.
winch unit
The winch unit attached to the shoulder reproduces the injection state with lead wires. Anchor parts in expanded state are included.
leg thread
In addition to the normal state of the legs, the state with the "sled" equipment for moving in wetlands is reproduced by selecting parts.
● Parked aircraft condition can be reproduced
The joint mechanism in the legs allows you to recreate the parking situation while standing on your knees.
● Delivered in a newly written full color package
Attached weapons: Winch unit equipment / Anchor (claw deployment) / Waist back weapon rack (with spare magazine) / Grenade spare bullet case / Rifle / Leg thread
1/72 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PVC
・No adhesive is used for assembly
